messages:
anya: Fuzzing found a local-privesc in our runtime shim (SUID helper). Need a tight rebuild + signing window. Can we split ownership: RBAC gating, staging key prep, and audit verification?

devops: I can do RBAC. proposing a temporary TF binding for ci-signer with condition limiting to the staging key and a request.time window. Will draft.

sec: Ill own audit checks. Ensure Cloud Audit Logs for AsymmetricSign + SetIamPolicy route to splunk-forwarder. Need a smoke test before cutover.

ci-bot: ci-bot: created branch "shim-fix/alpine-patch" and queued build 8245 (uses STAGING_KEY_URI if present).

devops: TF sketch: `google_service_account_iam_binding` with members=["serviceAccount:staging.ci.svc.id.goog[ci/signer]"] and condition `resource.name=="projects/redwood-staging/.../cosign-staging" && request.time < timestamp("2026-03-22T05:00:00Z")`

anya: CI smoke command for runbook:
```
printf '{"t":"canary"}' > /tmp/canary.json
cosign sign --key $KEY_URI /tmp/canary.json
cosign verify --key $PUBKEY_PEM /tmp/canary.json
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"AsymmetricSign" AND resource.labels.key_ring:"image-signing-staging"' --limit 10
```

sec: Splunk saved search: `index=cloud_logs protoPayload.methodName=AsymmetricSign | stats count by protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, resource.name` — alert if signer not ci/signer.

anya: Runbook fallback: 1) pause CI, 2) check gcloud logs for 403s, 3) verify SA binding and condition, 4) switch KEY_URI to backup staging key, 5) rollback image tag if signing fails.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build 8245 (shim-fix/alpine-patch) started with KEY_URI=projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing-staging/cryptoKeys/cosign-staging

devops: Opening PR with TF soon. tagging @sec and @anya.

sec: audit-bot confirms sink healthy. last export 2026-03-20T18:40:00Z.

anya: Target dry-run tomorrow 02:00 UTC, full window 03:30 UTC. Post PR links here and notify on-call before cutover.
